messages:
nina: Heads-up: after PartnerCloud's joint announcement the SKU id they send changed from `pc-edge-v2` -> `pc-edge-2026`. our SKU mapping table didn't pick it up and several customers show as "unmapped SKU" in daily billing. :grimacing:

sam: Oof. Is this a wholesale rename or versioned SKU? can you paste a sample from their webhook?

nina: sample from their batch webhook:

```json
{"tenant":"acme-global","timestamp":"2026-05-01T02:12:00Z","sku":"pc-edge-2026","usage_seconds":3600}
```

nina: Our mapping currently only has `pc-edge-v1` and `pc-edge-v2`.

eric_partner: Sorry, we pushed a post-announcement SKU consolidation yesterday and forgot to include the new mapping in the partner contract notification. We'll roll a mapping header `X-SKU-Canonical: pc-edge-v2` in next push. ETA 4h.

maria: Short-term mitigations:
1) Add ingest-side fallback: consult partner-provided header `X-SKU-Canonical` if present, else try heuristic normalization (strip-year suffix) and log `sku_inferred=true`.
2) Emit metric `sku_unmapped_count` by partner and tenant so finance can triage.

sam: Good. Also add an alert: if unmapped SKU > 0.1% of daily rows for a partner, page partnerships + finance. we should avoid silent underbilling.

ingest-bot: queued: feature=sku-heuristic, env=staging, expected deploy 8m. will emit `sku_unmapped_sample` logs for review.

eric_partner: We'll also backfill a manifest file mapping old->new SKUs and push it via the partner portal. will include a small test file with header `X-SKU-Canonical` set.

maria: For backfill plan: replay affected batches in backfill mode with `correction_id=partnercloud-skufix-20260501` and ensure idempotency by checking `backfill_id` ledger table. sample replay command for eng: 

```
curl -X POST https://staging-ingest.redwood.example/partner/partnercloud/replay \ 
  -H 'X-Correction-Id: partnercloud-skufix-20260501' \ 
  -F 'file=@./pc_backfill_20260501.json' \ 
  -F 'mode=backfill'
```

nina: Action items: sam (ingest fallback + alert), maria (backfill tooling + idempotency check), eric_partner (push mapping header + manifest), finance (prepare review queue). reconvene here after staging deploy and one backfill success. :thumbsup:
